clips.title: The story
paras: Warlocks in Ratchet receive the Tome of the Cabal from Strahad Farsan after gathering dangerous components. Its pages hold the incantations for drawing a felhunter across the Twisting Nether and binding it.

A felhunter is a vicious beast from the chaotic Twisting Nether, feared for devouring mana. Subduing one marks a passage for seasoned warlocks. The Tome of the Cabal holds the rites for opening a path to such a demon. Strahad Farsan, an experienced conjurer in Ratchet, gives the tome to an aspirant only after they gather the rare and dangerous components its magic requires.

Strahad Farsan establishes the primary summoning circle in his sanctum, while his acolytes use rods of channeling to form a greater protective boundary. The warlock recites the tome's exact incantations and drags the felhunter into our world. The demon must be battled at once and subdued, binding it to the warlock's will.
